newsitem.title: ITALY: BankItaly buys marks for lira under 1,000 -- dealers.
newsitem.headline: BankItaly buys marks for lira under 1,000 -- dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Italy is intervening in the foreign exchange market to buy lira for German marks when the Italian currency firms and pushes below 1,000 lire a mark, dealers said.
No one from the Bank of Italy was available for comment.
In the London foreign exchange market, dealers said they believed operators were buying marks for lire in the area of 998/999 lire a mark on behalf of the Bank of Italy.
At 1037 GMT, the lira was last quoted at 999.60/999.95 lire a mark.
